summary: Iteration 2 regression: all 3 fixes from iteration 1 verified end-to-end plus MVP sanity. Backend 6/6 pytest passing; frontend flows (QR preview, favorites sync with /api/favorites, history connected to /api/history with modal + delete) all working.
critical_code_review_comments: History delete endpoint always returns {ok: true} even for non-existent items; consider returning 404 when nothing matched to help clients detect stale state (minor).
useFavorites effect runs only on mount; if a user logs in without a full page reload, local favorites will not sync with server (edge case).
seed_data_creation: None – used existing seeded admin. Test data (favorite, generated history item) created and cleaned up during automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration-1 defects (QR preview binding, favorites sync, history integration) are fixed and verified. Backend regression suite covers health, google unconfigured, utility gen, favorites CRUD, history auth guard, history list+delete. Google OAuth remains an intentional mock.
